Hi Niel,

You're right that solo mining is a lottery. Every day a machine is running is another chance at a block, so I understand why the lost time matters to you.

Your request for a miner is still with the team, and they'll pick it up today. Their answer will come to you by email in this thread. I can't promise how they'll decide, but they have the full picture, including how long you've waited.

Sarah
